description: The figure is a two-level donut (nested pie) chart showing the distribution of conversation outcomes labeled as “Deceived,” “Partially,” and “Not Deceived” across two ambiguity settings, with the outer ring representing “Ambiguity 1 (Outer)” and the inner ring representing “Ambiguity 2 (Inner).” Each ring contains 3 slices (6 slices total across both rings). In the outer ring (Ambiguity 1), the “Deceived” slice is dark red at approximately 67.6%, the “Partially” slice is yellow at approximately 23.5%, and the “Not Deceived” slice is dark green at approximately 8.8%. In the inner ring (Ambiguity 2), the “Deceived” slice is red at approximately 57.9%, the “Partially” slice is yellow at approximately 31.6%, and the “Not Deceived” slice is light green at approximately 10.5%. Percentage values are printed directly on the slices, and two separate legends on the right map colors to labels for the outer and inner rings; no slices appear exploded or otherwise emphasized, and the segments appear arranged in a consistent color/label sequence around the circle.
